badge.name: Pathfinder
badge.description: Picks the right harness for the job.

card.title: Which harness?
lines: Longer reasoning, many tools, files, end-to-end processes → GitHub Copilot
Grounded answers inside Copilot Chat → Copilot chat
Skills and memory → GitHub Copilot harness only
GitHub Copilot harness uses credits from the first build step

steps.title: Three engines, three jobs
steps.text:
Everything you build in Copilot Studio runs on a **harness**.

- **Standard harness** – well-defined, rule-based scenarios. You design topics and paths, so answers are **consistent and predictable**. Example: an IT help desk for common questions.
- **GitHub Copilot harness** – reasoning-heavy, multistep work. You **describe the agent in natural language**; it plans, uses several tools, works with **large files** and adapts as it goes.
- **Copilot chat harness** – extends **Microsoft Copilot Chat** with your company's knowledge, so people get grounded answers where they already work.

steps.question: Which harness fits each Contoso scenario?

items.text: IT help desk: same answers every time, route password resets to a workflow
Compare 3 large supplier spreadsheets and create a Word report
Onboarding answers from SharePoint, right inside Copilot Chat
A guided, step-by-step return form that must always follow the same path
Investigate a delivery problem across several systems – the steps differ each time
A policy FAQ for all employees in their everyday Copilot

steps.explain: **Predictable & rule-based → Standard. Reasoning, files & many tools → GitHub Copilot. Knowledge inside Copilot Chat → Copilot chat.**

steps.question: Your agent must read three large Excel files, compare them and produce a Word report – and the steps are different every time. Which harness?
steps.hint: Large files + changing steps + creating documents.
steps.explain: The GitHub Copilot harness handles large files, adaptive multistep work, and can generate documents.

steps.question: Which building block is supported only in the GitHub Copilot harness?
steps.explain: **Skills** (and memory) are available in the GitHub Copilot harness. There, skills replace the prompt tool of the standard harness. Connectors, SharePoint knowledge and workflows work in both.

steps.question: When does an agent on the GitHub Copilot harness start using Copilot Credits?
options: From the moment you start building, testing and evaluating
Never – it's included in every Microsoft 365 Copilot license
Only when more than 100 people use it
steps.explain: The GitHub Copilot harness charges credits **from the moment you start building** – building, testing and evaluating included. The standard harness starts billing after publishing.

steps.question: BOSS: Contoso wants an agent that answers the 30 most common IT questions exactly the same way every time and sends password resets to an existing workflow. Best start?
options: GitHub Copilot harness – it's always better
Copilot chat harness – only because it's in Copilot
steps.explain: Well-defined, rule-based and predictable → **Standard harness**. Choose based on the job, not on what's newest.
